# mimecast Provider

Manage durable Mimecast administration configuration as code. This provider is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mimecast.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11.0"

  required_providers {
    mimecast = {
      source  = "Scriptception/mimecast"
      version = "~> 0.2"
    }
  }
}

provider "mimecast" {
  # Credentials use the canonical environment variables:
  # MIMECAST_ADDRESS
  # MIMECAST_CLIENT_ID
  # MIMECAST_SECRET
  read_only = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL for Mimecast API 2.0. May also be set via MIMECAST_ADDRESS or MIMECAST_BASE_URL. Defaults to `https://api.services.mimecast.com`.
- `client_id` (String) Mimecast API 2.0 client ID. May also be set via MIMECAST_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Mimecast API 2.0 client secret. May also be set via MIMECAST_SECRET or MIMECAST_CLIENT_SECRET.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. May also be set via MIMECAST_INSECURE. Disabled by default.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum retries for transient API failures and rate limits. May also be set via MIMECAST_MAX_RETRIES. Defaults to 4.
- `page_size` (Number) Page size for paginated list APIs. May also be set via MIMECAST_PAGE_SIZE. Defaults to 100.
- `proxy_url` (String, Sensitive) Dedicated HTTP or HTTPS proxy for Mimecast API and OAuth requests. May also be set via MIMECAST_PROXY_URL. This is separate from Terraform backend proxy settings.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Fail closed before every create, update, or delete request. May also be set via MIMECAST_READ_ONLY. Defaults to true.
- `scopes` (List of String) Optional OAuth scopes to request.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds. May also be set via MIMECAST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. Defaults to 30.
- `token_auth_method` (String) OAuth client authentication method. Supported values: `client_secret_post`, `client_secret_basic`. May also be set via MIMECAST_TOKEN_AUTH_METHOD. Defaults to `client_secret_post`.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth token endpoint. May also be set via MIMECAST_TOKEN_URL. When omitted, it is derived as `<base_url>/oauth/token`.
